profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Software Engineer at Microsoft, specializing in Unity 3D, video processing, and AI. Eager to learn more about both software and hardware!

educations.schoolName: Jesuit High School of Tampa, FL

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteered at monthly service projects. Organized different events and initiatives for volunteers. Managed  online functions for the club, including attendance tracking, service opportunities, informational pages, and volunteering signups. Compiled and managed monthly hour logging data using Regex patterns.

Worked with Key Club and the Special Olympics Athletes to train them for the Special Olympics Tennis Event. Supported and encouraged youths and young adults with disabilities. Aided development of physical coordination and promoted physical activity in disabled individuals
